tools.name: scan_endpoints
tools.description: Recursively scans a project directory (React Native, web, Flutter, or backend) for API endpoints — fetch/axios/Dart-http/Dio client calls and Express/NestJS/Flask/FastAPI/Spring server routes. Writes a discovery report and endpoints.json.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the project root.

tools.name: detect_openapi
tools.description: Searches the project for an existing OpenAPI/Swagger document (swagger.json, openapi.yaml, etc.) and reports what was found.

tools.name: generate_openapi
tools.description: Builds an OpenAPI 3.0 spec from discovered endpoints. If an existing spec is found and useExisting is true, it is loaded instead of regenerated. Writes the spec into the project's .api-mcp directory.

format.description: Output format for the spec file.

title.description: API title for the spec info block.

baseUrl.description: Server URL recorded in the spec's servers list.

useExisting.description: Reuse an existing spec in the project if one is found.

tools.name: generate_tests
tools.description: Generates a test plan (happy-path, edge, negative, and security cases) for every discovered endpoint, based on its HTTP method and parameters. Writes tests.json. Does not execute anything.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running server, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

bearerToken.description: Bearer token for Authorization header. Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

headers.description: Extra headers applied to every request. Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Generates the test plan and executes it against the running server (like Postman). Saves full responses to results.json and a Markdown report. Requires baseUrl unless endpoints use absolute URLs.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running server, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

bearerToken.description: Bearer token for Authorization header. Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

headers.description: Extra headers applied to every request. Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

categories.description: Only run these test categories. Omit to run all.

concurrency.description: How many requests to run in parallel.

dryRun.description: If true, list the planned requests without sending them.

tools.name: full_audit
tools.description: One-call pipeline: scans for endpoints, generates/loads an OpenAPI spec, generates test + edge cases, executes them against the live server, and writes all reports. Provide baseUrl and auth so execution can reach the server.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running server, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

bearerToken.description: Bearer token for Authorization header. Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

headers.description: Extra headers applied to every request. Supports ${ENV_VAR}.

execute.description: Set false to scan and generate artifacts without live execution.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Regenerates the HTML report and a colorful, multi-sheet XLSX spreadsheet from previously saved endpoints.json / results.json (in the project's .api-mcp folder). Use this to get shareable HTML/Excel output without re-running the tests.

tools.name: detect_base_url
tools.description: Scans config (.env), axios/Dart baseURL settings, and absolute URLs in the code to find candidate API base URLs. Works for web and mobile apps. QA can use the top candidate or override it.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Given a base URL and credentials, auto-detects the login endpoint, posts the credentials (trying email/username field variants), and extracts the token from the response. Returns the token and reports exactly what worked.

path.description: Project root path (used to auto-detect login endpoint).

baseUrl.description: API base URL. If omitted, the top detected candidate is used.

tools.name: qa_audit
tools.description: The QA one-call workflow. Provide the project path and a list of role credentials (email/username + password). The tool detects the base URL and login endpoint, logs in as each role, runs the test suite per role (read-only by default), and writes a per-role + combined report. Set includeWrites=true only against a throwaway/staging env.

baseUrl.description: API base URL. Omit to auto-detect from the code.

token.description: Pre-obtained bearer token for this role (e.g. a Clerk/Auth0/SSO JWT copied from the host). If set, auto-login is skipped and this token is used directly.

headers.description: Extra headers sent on every request made AS this role (merged before the bearer). For schemes that pick the user by header, e.g. a staging dev-bypass sharing one token across users: { 'x-dev-user-id': '<id>' }.

roles.description: Per role: either email/username + password (auto-login), or a pre-obtained token. e.g. [{role:'admin',email:'a@x.com',password:'…'}] or [{role:'admin',token:'eyJ…'}].

includeWrites.description: Include POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE tests. Only for throwaway/staging envs.

realisticBodies.description: Fill write bodies with seeded, realistic Faker values (names, emails, dates) instead of fixed placeholders. Reproducible across runs. Needs the optional @faker-js/faker dependency; only affects includeWrites runs.

includeDestructive.description: Also test session-breaking endpoints (logout, refresh-token, delete-account, password reset, register). Off by default — testing logout revokes your own token.

roleScoped.description: Test each role only on endpoints its route-guard allows (plus unguarded ones), so you get more real 200s and far fewer 403/404s. Set false for full coverage.

maxRateLimitWaitMs.description: Max ms to pace a request when the server's rate-limit budget is low. Raise toward the reset window (e.g. 900000) for exhaustive coverage under strict limits.
